decisions.reason: The Definition correctly confines -pI3 to isotropic traction, but the final Remark incorrectly makes positive fluid pressure sufficient for isotropic total stress. A Newtonian shear u=(gamma*x2,0,0) with eta>0 and p>0 has sigma12=sigma21=eta*gamma. Qualified that Remark by an explicit isotropic-total-stress assumption; the Definition and physical_scope are unchanged.

Read Stewart Section 6.1 through its elastic-rod wave-equation derivation and field discussion. The source title wrongly attributes this item's standing-wave comparison to that section. Replaced only the title's description by the actual chain/rod scope and identified the numerical comparison as locally verified; no deduction depends on that external attribution.

The claimed implication from C2 motion/J>0 and C1 fields to exclusion of every material interface is false: identity motion, constant positive density and u=b=sigma=0 satisfy those analytical conditions and both balance integrals across a marked plane. This is not a model counterexample to clause (iv), which independently excludes interfaces by adoption. Repaired the scope and Remark to distinguish these facts; also removed the false blanket corner exclusion, since the balance postulate permits piecewise C1 faces and null edges.
